**Resubmitted: deviation (RENEWAL), fallback-level cure.**

What changed in response to the verifier: the earlier edit swapped only the numeral pair, so the inserted text read "sixty (60)" with "days" left in the retained words and the required "60 days" window never appeared as new operative language. The revised single replace now carries the whole window phrase in the inserted text:

- **Before:** "...unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other."
- **After:** "...unless terminated by either Party hereto upon written notice to the other at least sixty (60) days in advance."

- **Fallback coverage:** notice window element addressed by operation 1 (60 days in operative text); price-uplift element untriggered/already met via the fixed 30% Net Sales fee in Section 3.1.
- **Intent check:** the mutual notice structure is retained deliberately (so we keep our own ability to exit on notice at any time rather than only at an anniversary), and the following sentence's "Termination Date" definition and the Section 4.2 termination-payment mechanics continue to operate without dangling references.
- Preferred level (mutual-agreement renewal, 30-day opt-out, 60-day vendor reminder, CPI/3% cap) remains our better position and is flagged in the comment, not drafted, to keep the edit minimal.
